heading: Portfolio
subheading: Complete, CMS-driven projects — every page, image and record managed from an admin panel.

projects.title: Photography Website
projects.summary: A photography studio website with a fully managed gallery and a session booking system.
projects.description: A complete website for a photographer where every section — galleries, albums, services, packages and testimonials — is controlled from a custom admin panel. Clients can browse portfolios and book a shoot online; the admin reviews, confirms or reschedules bookings from the dashboard.
features: Admin-managed galleries and albums with image upload
Service and package management with pricing
Online session booking with date selection
Booking dashboard — confirm, reschedule or cancel
Editable testimonials, about and contact content

projects.title: Real Estate Website
projects.summary: Property listings with search, site-visit booking and online payment — all admin-managed.
projects.description: A real-estate platform where the admin adds and manages property listings with photos, pricing, location and amenities. Visitors can search and filter properties, book a site visit or reservation, and pay online. Bookings and payments are tracked in the admin dashboard.
features: Property CRUD with multiple images and amenities
Search and filter by type, location and price
Admin dashboard for bookings, payments and enquiries

projects.title: Ved Mandir
projects.summary: A fully dynamic temple website — events, pujas, gallery and announcements managed by the temple team.
projects.description: A dynamic website for Ved Mandir where the temple committee manages everything from the admin panel: daily timings, upcoming events and festivals, puja services, photo gallery, announcements and donation information. No content is hard-coded.
features: Fully dynamic pages driven by the CMS
Editable temple timings and contact details

projects.title: Solar Company Website
projects.summary: A corporate website for a solar energy company with products, projects and leads managed in a CMS.
projects.description: A business website for a solar company showcasing solar products, installation services and completed projects. The admin panel controls products, services, project case studies, banners and incoming enquiries.
features: Enquiry / lead management in the dashboard

projects.title: Visitor Management System
projects.summary: Register, track and report on visitors — check-in, check-out and history in one place.
projects.description: A web application for organisations to manage visitors. Reception staff register visitors with their details and purpose of visit, record check-in and check-out times, and look up past visits. Admins get reports and can filter visitor history by date and host.
features: Visitor registration with purpose and host
